mainEntity.name: How do I go to the next chapter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the arrows in the band at the top, the arrow keys, or the arrows on the floating bar on a phone. The Books pane opens any chapter directly.

mainEntity.name: How do I read two translations side by side?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open a parallel pane and choose the second translation. The panes stay level verse by verse, even when one translation merges verses that another keeps apart, and they scroll together.

mainEntity.name: How do I change the text size or layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: The size button in the status bar opens the reading panel: text size, line height, line length and verse layout (paragraph, one verse per line, or continuous).

mainEntity.name: How do I switch to another translation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Press the translation's name in the status bar or in the crumb bar over the text, and choose another one that is on this device.

mainEntity.name: Can the Bible be read aloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, with the voices on this device. Press Read aloud in the ribbon; choose a voice in Settings → Reading. Where no voice exists for a language, a voice in another language can read it.
